name: 47553 · Loogootee, IN
findings: ZIP 47553 (Loogootee) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47553 (Loogootee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47553 (Loogootee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
